benchmarks.gate: screen expectancy must beat BOTH zero AND the control null to be interesting
benchmarks.honest_prior: ~0 or negative; target is positive expectancy, NOT 'double every hour'
benchmarks.metric: EXPECTANCY = winrate*avgWinR - lossrate*avgLossR per trade, NET of the ~3% round-trip toll
benchmarks.null: control = same sizing/stop/target on a deterministic sample of screen-REJECT coins

kill_switch.rule: HALT if, after n>=N_min resolved PASS trades, mean_R + 1.645*SE < 0 (forward expectancy significantly negative).
